# Examples: agent frameworks

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_examples_gallery.py; edit the examples, not this. -->

Registry tools inside each agent framework. Back to the [Examples gallery](../examples.md). Files here: 22.

| File | Shows | Install | Run | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/adk_tools.py` | Google ADK: registry tools as BaseTools; your approval port answers ADK's confirmations. | `pip install "agent-adapter[adk]"` | `python examples/adk_tools.py` | [Google ADK](../integrations/adk.md) |
| `examples/ag2_tools.py` | AG2: registry tools as FunctionTools; an approval gate in AG2's tool middleware asks one port. | `pip install "agent-adapter[ag2]"` | `python examples/ag2_tools.py` | [AG2](../integrations/ag2.md) |
| `examples/agent_framework_tools.py` | Microsoft Agent Framework: registry tools as FunctionTools; one approval port decides. | `pip install "agent-adapter[agent-framework]"` | `python examples/agent_framework_tools.py` | [Microsoft Agent Framework](../integrations/agent-framework.md) |
| `examples/agno_tools.py` | Agno: registry tools as Functions; one approval port resolves Agno's confirmation pauses. | `pip install "agent-adapter[agno]"` | `python examples/agno_tools.py` | [Agno](../integrations/agno.md) |
| `examples/autogen_tools.py` | Run registry tools in AutoGen 0.7: the workbench path, then an `AssistantAgent` (offline). | `pip install "agent-adapter[autogen]"` | `python examples/autogen_tools.py` | [AutoGen](../integrations/autogen.md) |
| `examples/camel_tools.py` | CAMEL-AI: registry tools as FunctionTools; the executor's approval port decides confirm tools. | `pip install "agent-adapter[camel]"` | `python examples/camel_tools.py` | [CAMEL-AI](../integrations/camel.md) |
| `examples/claude_agent_tools.py` | Claude Agent SDK: registry tools on an in-process MCP server, gated by the same bridge. | `pip install "agent-adapter[claude-agent]"` | `python examples/claude_agent_tools.py` | [Claude Agent SDK](../integrations/claude-agent.md) |
| `examples/crewai_tools.py` | CrewAI: registry tools as BaseTools (sync `run` via run_sync, async `arun`). | `pip install "agent-adapter[crewai]"` | `python examples/crewai_tools.py` | [CrewAI](../integrations/crewai.md) |
| `examples/dspy_tools.py` | Run registry tools in DSPy: `acall` directly, then inside `dspy.ReAct` (offline LM). | `pip install "agent-adapter[dspy]"` | `python examples/dspy_tools.py` | [DSPy](../integrations/dspy.md) |
| `examples/gemini_afc.py` | Run Gemini function calls through the executor, by hand or with genai AFC. | `pip install "agent-adapter[gemini]"` | `python examples/gemini_afc.py` | [Gemini](../integrations/gemini.md) |
| `examples/haystack_tools.py` | Haystack: registry tools as Tools; a before_tool confirmation hook asks an approval port. | `pip install "agent-adapter[haystack]"` | `python examples/haystack_tools.py` | [Haystack](../integrations/haystack.md) |

| `examples/openai_agents_tools.py` | OpenAI Agents SDK: registry tools as FunctionTools, with an approval that edits arguments. | `pip install "agent-adapter[openai-agents]"` | `python examples/openai_agents_tools.py` | [OpenAI Agents SDK](../integrations/openai-agents.md) |
